description: Read registered Zustand stores, available state keys, change counts and persistence metadata. includeValues:true requests values. Pass store (and optionally path, like "member.crowns") to read just one store or one value. Use get_events with sources:["zustand"] for retained changes.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

includeValues.description: Include each store's full current state object (HEAVY). Default false (keys only).

path.description: With store: read one value by dot path, e.g. "member.crowns" or "lines.0.id".

store.description: Read only this store (name from the list), with its values.

name: get_zustand_state
